# extract_leading_eeof_component { #wass2s.extract_leading_eeof_component }

```python
extract_leading_eeof_component(data)
```

extract leading eeof component using ExtendedEOF.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                               | Default    |
|--------|------------------|-------------------------------------------|------------|
| data   | xarray.DataArray | Input data array with time dimension 'T'. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                |
|--------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | xarray.DataArray | Trended data array based on the first mode of ExtendedEOF. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type         | Description                   |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------|
|        | RuntimeError | If ExtendedEOF fitting fails. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Missing values are filled with the time mean before fitting.
Uses ExtendedEOF with specified parameters (n_modes=2, tau=1, embedding=3, n_pca_modes=20).
